### How this work is cited

Passages inside The Human Condition are identified by chapter and section. Written in English by Arendt herself; the German version, Vita activa, is her own reworking rather than a translation of it, and the two differ in places.

### The work in Hannah Arendt’s thought

Hannah Arendt (1906–1975) was a German-Jewish political theorist who fled Nazism and wrote in the United States in English and German. A student of Heidegger and Jaspers, she refused the label “philosopher” yet produced lasting works on totalitarianism, revolution, and the vita activa. [More on Hannah Arendt](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/hannah-arendt) .
